name: Shrimps
description: Shrimps - the source's 'Crevettes' compartment, built from Sine-Saloum invertebrate data refined by isotope work: the penaeid shrimps of the muddy channel, filtering zooplankton and phytoplankton. They are the single most important prey of the creek's predators - rays, catfish, ladyfish, threadfin and barracudas all hunt them. Functional group pooling the source's shrimps compartment.
